verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence touching this story is the vague Perplexity Labs claim to 'bring your reports and projects to life' (docs-10), which suggests report or project generation but documents nothing specific. The Computer sandbox's ability to write and run code (docs-17) and email drafting (docs-9) are developer building blocks or adjacent features, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: explicit document/presentation/file creation, iterative editing of generated files, export formats, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
